title: Grilled Syrian Pasta
description: A hearty, flavorful pasta dish inspired by Syrian cuisine, featuring grilled vegetables and a zesty sauce.
instructions: Grill eggplant, zucchini, and red bell pepper for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly charred.
Slice the grilled vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Cook penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Add grilled vegetables, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet. Toss to combine.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the vegetable sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
